limitations: Covariance shares are descriptive, not causal or independent importance scores.
Historical own-version is often unknown; diagnose the team, then reproduce in frozen v111 locally.
Full-state replay diagnostics are offline only; legal bot visibility must be checked before changes.
Farming windows measure collection differences, not a counterfactual route or cost of death.
